description: GRF simulated Redcastle Town–Port Albion. Fictional Elephant League clubs and players; not an actual match.

provenance.source: Google Research Football instrumented native runtime

script.summary: Port Albion press high and attack down the right; Redcastle Town play more directly. Spells of pressure alternate; Port Albion tire in the last quarter while Redcastle Town push; the team ahead after an hour sits deep and the team behind pushes.

limitations: Synthetic simulation, not official Opta data or an actual fixture.
Names map simulator slots; player abilities are generic.
Headed pass/shot classification requires an executed header with explicit native action intent.
Pass completion means first subsequent intentional teammate touch; event time is resolution.
Possession measures confirmed native ownership ticks; loose-ball and stoppage time excluded.

Referee decisions and taken restarts are native observations; tackles, interceptions, saves, shot outcomes, aerials, take-ons and recoveries are rule-derived from native tracking (docs/opta-events.md).
No xG, substitutions, injuries or VAR.
Engine patched for realism (prepare_realism.py); knob values in provenance.realism.
Team tactics are scripted per fixture (tactics.json) through engine knobs (prepare_tactics.py); the built-in AIs still make every decision. Script and changes in provenance.tactics.
provenance.contact_coalescing: Continuous same-player/function/type callbacks with gaps<=300ms form one action.
provenance.scoring_attempts: A linked scored shot is represented once as goal; raw native shot remains in capture.
provenance.presentation: Real time: video seconds equal capture seconds. The broadcast clock runs through dead play, so each half ends in stoppage time.
